format.GRH: 300-byte header, big-endian width/height, raw indexed pixels
format.palette_loading: PAL RGB triples written starting at DAC index 1, not 0; 6-bit channels
format.HEAD2.GRH: 198x16 menu head strip; inspect START.EXE before integration
format.WEAPON.GRH: 270x112;15x8 grid,pitch18x14,rendered17x13; some larger regions are also cropped

verified.Davis_reconstruction: ACT1 frame2 + HEAD head1, overlay at0,0, crop x1..17; shared body masks exactly match original GIF
verified.Julian: DATA.DAT head11 + Skn10,10 + Sht93,94 + Trs119,120; same shared renderer
verified.head_cropping: divisor11, source x=(head-1)%11*18+1,y=(head-1)//11*13+1; head drawn when frame tables permit
verified.body_palette: nine source colors mapped into per-entity bank151+slot*10; body blit uses slot*10 additive index shift
verified.body_animation: shared standard ACT1 frames, with head position controlled by frame-indexed tables; specialized body poses in ACT1/ACT2 can contain baked-in character graphics

Disaster: new upward yellow seed projectile; new movement and targeting behavior
Volcano: Firen explosion imagery; distinguish larger ACT2 regions and small WEAPON bursts
new ice-column growth, active, and break frames
LF2 Volcano also launches fire/ice chase projectiles
ACT2 frame93 includes baked-in Firen artwork; Firzen-specific face/body adaptation is needed if reusing that entire casting frame.
Cannon: new front projectile/beam segments and hit effect
casting poses based on shared body when possible

new_art_needed: Firzen head poses within HEAD 17x12 crop
special projectile/effect art and any required unique casting pose
integration_notes: Head grid uses hardcoded11-column division; cannot blindly append a column without changing addressing
Standard bodies should remain shared; palette can represent yellow torso and dark trousers
Cape or separately colored gloves/boots would require additional body/overlay art and renderer work
Special effects are separate entity graphics, not a whole per-character walking spritesheet
No gameplay code or existing game assets changed at preview stage
